T: What happens in Vegas gets eaten in Vegas.
D: Three friends wake up in a trashed Las Vegas suite with no memory of the night and no sign of the groom.
P: Serve the drinks when the Wolf Pack toasts on the roof.
S: Prawns poached 2 minutes, iced, piled high on crushed ice with cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon.
waking up with a tiger in the bathroom
Grated potato squeezed dry, seasoned, pressed into thin cakes, fried in butter and oil until deep golden, a fried egg on top.
the chicken wandering around the suite
Chicken breast in chunks, brined in buttermilk, coated in seasoned flour and crushed cornflakes, fried at 175C for 4 minutes. Honey mustard.
M: a big night on the Strip
Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with creamed spinach, a loaded baked potato and béarnaise.
Flour tortillas filled with soft scrambled eggs, chorizo, potato, cheddar and salsa, rolled, toasted in a dry pan.
W: the wedding they barely make it back for
Lemon butter cake baked at 170C, split and filled with lemon curd and vanilla buttercream, covered smooth and chilled before slicing.
K: the toast on the roof before it all goes wrong
30ml shots of chilled herbal liqueur, or a cold lager for anyone sensible.

s.how: Poach 600g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel, leaving the tails on. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish and lemon juice. Pile the prawns on a bag of crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.

s.note: waking up with a tiger in the bathroom
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze out as much liquid as you can and season well. Press into 8 thin cakes and fry in 40g butter and a little oil for 5 minutes a side until deep golden. Top each with a fried egg and chives.

m.how: Dice and fry 300g potatoes until crisp, then add 200g diced chorizo. Softly scramble 8 eggs. Fill 4 large flour tortillas with the eggs, potato, chorizo, 100g cheddar and a fresh salsa of 2 tomatoes and onion. Roll and toast in a dry pan.

w.note: the wedding they barely make it back for
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and lemon zest. Bake in two tins at 170C for 25 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and cover with 250g butter beaten with 400g icing sugar. Chill before slicing.

d.note: the toast on the roof before it all goes wrong
d.how: Put a bottle of herbal liqueur and four shot glasses in the freezer for an hour. Pour 30ml into each glass and toast on the roof. Keep a few cold lagers in the fridge for anyone who would rather remember the night.
